tha-ap157:1.1: Mandāravapūjaka.] Devaputto ahaṃ santo pujesiṃ Sikhināyakaṃ / mandāravena pupphena Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap157:2.1: Sattāhaṃ chadanaṃ āsi dibbaṃ mālyaṃ Tathāgate / sabbe janā samāgantvā namassiṃsu Tathāgataṃ. // //
tha-ap157:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap157:4.1: Ito ca dasame kappe rājā 'hosiṃ Jutindharo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap157:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Mandāravapūjako thero i. g. ā-ti. Mandāravapūjakattherassa
